attributes.title: 8th Annual Ocean City Conference 2027
attributes.venue: Hilton Garden Inn Ocean City Oceanfront
attributes.organizer: National Association of Social Workers, Maryland Chapter
attributes.summary:
The Maryland Chapter of the National Association of Social Workers holds its 8th Annual Ocean City Conference from Wednesday, May 5, to Friday, May 7, 2027, at the Hilton Garden Inn Ocean City Oceanfront on Baltimore Avenue. The chapter lists the event as a save-the-date on its continuing education page; the program, fees and CE totals had not been published when we checked.

NASW Maryland runs a full calendar of CE programs for social workers and labels its live workshops by Maryland CE category (most are Category I). NASW members receive free or discounted CE through chapter programs.

The chapter's other big spring event in 2027 is the joint DC, Maryland and Virginia conference in March. Check the chapter page for registration details and the hours offered before you plan your renewal.
